dedupe_rule: unique symbol; newest reverse-trace sample wins when symbols repeat
interpretation: Median is preferred over mean because OI has large outliers such as PHA/ARK.
Most common baseline is not extreme RVOL or extreme OI; many samples are still relatively quiet before expansion.
Taker >=1.0 is common but >=1.2 is not universal, so treat flow as confirmation/archetype rather than a universal hard gate.
OI 4H >=1% captures only a subset; preserve OI-neutral/negative FLOW/RVOL archetypes.
